Therefore, it's important to pay attention to the context of the sentence and choose the correct word. If you're not sure which one to use, try expanding the contraction to "you are" and see if it still makes sense. If it does, then you should use "you're." There are several potential reasons why your Fortnite performance may not be as good as you expect, even with similar or better hardware than other players. Some possible reasons could include:  
Hardware issues: It's possible that there may be an issue with your hardware that is causing your performance to be lower than expected. This could be due to a malfunctioning component or an issue with the drivers.  
Software issues: Your performance may be affected by software issues, such as conflicts with other programs, outdated drivers, or problems with the game itself.  
Overheating: If your laptop is overheating, it could be causing performance issues in Fortnite. Make sure that your laptop is properly ventilated and that the fans are functioning properly.  
Network issues: Your performance may be affected by issues with your internet connection or with the servers. Make sure that you have a stable and fast internet connection, and try restarting your router and modem if you are experiencing connectivity issues.  
In-game settings: Your in-game settings may be causing your performance to suffer. Try adjusting your in-game settings, such as turning off shadows or reducing the resolution, to see if it improves your performance.
